classification.difficultyReason: Apply the demonstrated complement methods: group the forbidden adjacent pair in (a), and in (b) assign both named students to distinct relay positions before filling the remaining positions and subtracting.

children.label: a
children.prompt: 8 people are to stand in a line. Georgina and Harriet do not wish to stand together. How many ways are there of arranging the 8 people?

answer.worked:
Total arrangements: $8!$.

For unacceptable arrangements, treat Georgina and Harriet as one unit. Arrange the seven units, then arrange the two people within their unit: $7!\times2!$.

$$\begin{aligned}\text{Acceptable arrangements}&=8!-7!\times2!\\&=40\,320-10\,080\\&=30\,240.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: 8 students are trying out for a relay race team with four positions: first leg, second leg, third leg, anchor. Two of the students, Marcus and Sophie, cannot both be on the team. How many ways are there of selecting the team?

answer.worked:
Total ordered teams: ${}^{8}P_{4}$.

For unacceptable teams, choose Marcus’s position in 4 ways and Sophie’s position in 3 ways. Fill the remaining two positions from the other six students in $6\times5$ ways.

$$\begin{aligned}\text{Acceptable teams}&={}^{8}P_{4}-4\times3\times6\times5\\&=1680-360\\&=1320.\end{aligned}$$
